purpose: Personal, non-production historical research only; never arms or supplies models to the legacy public-data paper accounts.

dataset.timestamps: Integer milliseconds before 2025; integer microseconds from 2025. Normalize explicitly without floating timestamp conversion.
dataset.integrity: Verify each published SHA256 before parsing. Require exact symbol/interval/month/member identity, bounded ZIP and CSV, finite positive OHLC with valid ranges, nonnegative volumes/trades, exact UTC bar/close boundaries. Reject conflicting or duplicate bars and overlong, future, misaligned or out-of-range rows. For an otherwise valid aligned in-month historical row with the expected timestamp unit and a positive declared duration shorter than four hours, reject the row and record its timestamp, duration and missing slot; never round, extend or use its OHLCV. Report all missing slots; no forward filling.
dataset.coverage_policy: All 168 monthly archives must be verified before evaluation; missing slots invalidate affected lookbacks/targets and are reported. Never change the date window because of returns.
dataset.licensing: Dataset and derived results/charts/models: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 under Binance dataset terms. Personal non-production research only; no commercial/live proprietary trading use. Code licensing is separate.

decision.available_information: Closed bars through the previous day's 20:00-24:00 UTC bar only.
decision.entry: 04:00 UTC on the signal day, using the actual exchange bar open after a full four-hour delay.
decision.target_end: 04:00 UTC the following day, actual exchange bar open; 24-hour holding-return label.
features: population standard deviation of 20 daily close returns
previous day's high-low range divided by latest close
previous day's base volume / mean base volume of the preceding 20 days minus 1
latest close / mean of the latest 20 daily closes minus 1
decision.gap_policy: Any missing bar in the 126-bar feature window invalidates that as-of feature decision. A supervised label additionally requires complete signal-to-exit bars and positive volume over its execution window. Missing future label data never removes or changes an earlier feature decision or strategy target. Dataset-start warmup is excluded explicitly.
decision.label: 1 when actual next-day 04:00 open / signal-day 04:00 open - 1 > 0, before costs.
decision.zero_volume_execution_guard: For supervised labels require strictly positive base volume in all actual execution/holding-window bars, including entry and exit bars. At a live simulation entry, require only the observed entry bar to have positive volume; future holding or exit bars cannot retroactively suppress the decision or fill. If a desired execution open is missing or has zero volume, take no fill there and carry an existing position to the next valid observed open. Never claim a fill in a non-trading bar.

model.selection: Validation base-cost net return, then lower validation max drawdown, then lower threshold. Comparator p >= threshold. Cash/no-trade outcomes remain valid; no minimum-trade requirement.

partitions.boundary_purge: Every retained outcome must end strictly before the next partition boundary at 00:00 UTC. No label may reach the next split. The test tail is also bounded by its calendar end.
partitions.final_status: Newly reserved historical test, retrospective rather than prospective. Freeze final parameters before any final-period evaluation. Record consumed_at on first evaluation; subsequent use is reused historical evidence.
partitions.previously_inspected_exclusion: October 2026 is excluded from fresh-test claims.

accounting.position_policy: Daily binary target: enter half-budget when active and flat, hold the same quantity while active, sell when inactive. No daily round-trip or rebalance while target remains active. Liquidate at the final target-end open.
accounting.risk_observation: Daily execution/mark opens only; sell on observed halt, remain in cash until fold end. A gap can overshoot the threshold; no guaranteed stop price.
accounting.reset: Each strategy/cost/fold begins with fresh 10000 USDT and a fresh risk high-water mark. Development returns are independent fold-reset experiments, not one uninterrupted account.
baselines: positive fixed 7-day momentum with identical target policy
half-budget buy-and-hold with identical dates/costs/risk halt
accounting.sensitivity: Select thresholds only at base validation costs; freeze model/threshold/target signals across all cost scenarios. Identical risk rules can halt cost scenarios at different times. Never select a scenario by test performance.
accounting.missing_decision_policy: No action on invalid/missing daily decisions. An existing position is carried to the next valid observed open; mark and apply risk there. No backfilled trades; gaps can overshoot the halt. Report all excluded daily rows and calendar gaps.

uncertainty.method: Seeded circular moving-block bootstrap of daily OOS returns and paired daily model-minus-buyhold return differences
uncertainty.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentiles of compounded bootstrap returns; paired excess uses mean daily excess in basis points.
uncertainty.interpretation: Descriptive historical intervals, not a proof of independent returns or an edge. Zero-trade/zero-volatility intervals cannot support a predictive claim. No unguarded annualized Sharpe.

classification: log loss with numerical probability clipping to [1e-15,1-1e-15]
fixed reliability bins [0,.1),[.1,.2),...,[.9,1] with counts,mean predicted probability,observed positive share
evaluation_diagnostics.purpose: Evaluation diagnostics only; no probability recalibration, threshold changes or model selection on development tests or final test.
